definitions.explanation: Someone who has just joined an organization, started a job, or entered a field.

examples.japanese: {新人|しんじん}{研修|けんしゅう}を{受|う}けた。
{今年|ことし}の{新人|しんじん}は{優秀|ゆうしゅう}だ。
examples.english: This year's new employees are excellent.

examples.japanese: {新人|しんじん}{歌手|かしゅ}がデビューした。
examples.english: A new singer made their debut.

notes:
Used for new members of a company, organization, or profession.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{新人|しんじん}{社員|しゃいん} (new employee)
・{新人|しんじん}{研修|けんしゅう} (new employee training)
・{新人|しんじん}{歌手|かしゅ} (new singer)
・{新人|しんじん}{賞|しょう} (newcomer award)

RELATED TERMS:
・{先輩|せんぱい} (senior)
・{後輩|こうはい} (junior)
